missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Небо' is the neuter nominative subject. 'Синее' is the agreeing neuter adjective, and 'очень' intensifies it.
Strategic focus: Accusative after preposition. 'Небо' is the accusative after 'на' to express looking at it; the neuter form matches the nominative. 'Смотреть' is the infinitive.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Небе' is the prepositional form after 'на' for location. 'Нет ни облака' uses the genitive of negation.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Неба' is genitive showing the colour belongs to the sky. 'Цвет' is the nominative subject of 'становится'.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Небе' is prepositional after 'в' to mark where the birds fly. 'Птицы' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Небу' is the dative form after 'к' to express movement toward the sky. 'Самолёт' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Небом' is instrumental after 'под' to mean under the sky. 'Чистым' agrees in the neuter instrumental.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Небо' is the neuter nominative subject. 'Вечернее' and 'красивое' both agree as neuter adjectives.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Небеса' is the irregular nominative plural of небо, common in poetic use. 'Чистые' agrees in the plural, and 'над нами' is instrumental.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after verb. 'Небом' is instrumental, required by 'любуемся' meaning to admire. 'Ночным' agrees in the neuter instrumental.
